task.description:
Validate src/design/iss0630-migration-scope-qualification-fix.md before BACKEND-DEV implements it. This is ISS-0630/GH-605, a BLOCKER: 9 migration files declare '-- scope: public' but contain unqualified table statements, breaking fresh-database migration bootstrap.

ORCH already independently verified the core claims with hands-on reproduction: (1) created a genuinely fresh PostgreSQL database and ran zig build migrate against it directly -- confirmed it fails at 011_webhook_subscriptions.sql with the exact scope-mismatch error the issue describes; (2) confirmed this workspace's own long-lived db_test container has 011 already recorded as applied since 2026-08-06, before the defect-introducing commit a2a8c68 merged on 2026-08-08 -- confirming the 'shared_db_masking' narrative precisely; (3) read src/db/migrations.zig's declaresUnqualifiedTableWork() directly and confirmed its exact heads list (CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE, INSERT INTO -- NOT CREATE INDEX) and line-by-line whole-file scanning behavior matches the design's characterization exactly; (4) confirmed migrations/094_entity_subsystem.sql genuinely has its scope comment at line 22 and an INSERT INTO at line 102 (80 lines away, outside any DO block the 3 CREATE TABLEs might be inside) -- confirming the design's claim that all 4 statements in this file need qualification, not just the 3 near the header; (5) confirmed lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 (29 expected MINOR E030 findings for the public.-qualified names the design itself specifies, non-blocking).

YOUR JOB: run your own full independent validation.
1. Read the design fresh.
2. Re-verify all 9 files' exact required edits yourself against the real file content -- don't just trust the design's table.
3. Confirm the design's claim of zero intra-file FK/REFERENCES needing qualification is accurate (grep the 9 files yourself).
4. Verify the new fresh_database_migration CI job design (Postgres service container, migrate against empty DB, judged by exit code) is well-specified and consistent with CLAUDE.md's 'prefer exit code over string match' gate-design principle.
5. Confirm the design's claim that no existing CI job already covers this (check .github/workflows/ci.yml yourself for any Postgres service block).
6. Confirm scope discipline: no backfill/corrective migration proposed, the 35 residual test-integration-svc failures explicitly excluded.
acceptance_criteria: All 9 files' required edits independently re-verified against real content
Zero intra-file FK/REFERENCES needing qualification confirmed
New CI gate design well-specified, exit-code-judged
No existing CI gate covers this confirmed
Scope discipline confirmed (no backfill, 35 residual failures excluded)

result.summary: Independently re-verified src/design/iss0630-migration-scope-qualification-fix.md against all 9 real migration files, migrations.zig source, and .github/workflows/ci.yml. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 (29 MINOR-only E030 findings for the deliberate public.-qualified names, non-blocking). declaresUnqualifiedTableWork() head list (CREATE/ALTER/DROP TABLE, INSERT INTO -- no CREATE INDEX) and whole-file scan (using the 16MiB sql_bytes read, not the 4096-byte header probe) confirmed by direct source read at migrations.zig:651-684 and the guard call site at migrations.zig:401-419. All 9 files read in full; every unqualified statement the design lists is real, and file 094 structure independently confirmed (scope comment line 22 inside a DO block, INSERT INTO event_type_registry at line 102 outside any DO block). Zero REFERENCES across all 9 files confirmed via direct grep. ci.yml confirmed to have zero services: blocks across all 6 jobs; build job comment documents its own no-DB scope, supporting the design rationale for a new dedicated job. New fresh_database_migration job judged by zig build migrate exit code only, consistent with CLAUDE.md gate-design principle. No implementation code or SQL DDL present in the design (only a CI YAML spec, which is explicitly in scope). No backfill/corrective migration proposed; all edits idempotent. 35 residual test-integration-svc failures explicitly excluded and traced to a real diagnosis file (docs/issue-reports/ISS-0150-gh482-20260809-diagnosis.yaml).
